arrangeSeconds.name: Advisory area duration (seconds)
arrangeSeconds.hint: After a troop unit move, valid segment placements are highlighted for this long. While the highlight is visible, dragging a segment to a spot inside it repositions only that segment; dragging outside it (or after it fades) moves the whole formation.

troopReduced.message: {name} is reduced to {segments} segments. Maximum Hit Points are capped at {hp} until the troop recovers (remove the Troop Reduced effect after downtime recovery).
troopReduced.healCapped: {name}: healing capped at {hp} HP while the troop is reduced.
